Database.// UseMigrations: false rebuilds the database whenever the model changes — fine until you care about the data in it. Run scripts\migrations.ps1, then set this to true.

Frontend.// UseDevServer: Set to true while `npm run dev` is running in /client for hot reload.

Payments.// AllowTestCard: The built-in card checkout (any Luhn-valid number, e-mailed code) takes no money. On only here; a live site uses Stripe.
